assertions.assert: env:<slot>="NAME" binds the element's slot <slot> to the variable NAME; the host substitutes NAME's value.

env:<slot>expr="EXPR" binds the slot to the variable whose name EXPR evaluates to in the document's data model when the element executes; a value that is not a string naming a variable, or a failed evaluation, raises error.execution.

An element's slots are the ones its package declares (env-slots): a slot the package does not declare, a slot bound twice (env:<slot> and env:<slot>expr), or an env:<slot> value that is not a variable name is rejected (SCXML083).

The vocabulary has attributes only: an element in the env namespace, or an env attribute on an element in no namespace, is rejected (SCXML084), and an env attribute on an SCXML element is rejected (SCXML068).

A slot whose variable the run holds no value for is absent: the element's component decides what that means (openai raises error.execution without a key and sends nothing; without a base URL it uses its default endpoint).
Each execution binds the element's own slots: another element, of the same or another namespace, never receives them.

The host substitutes a value only into the element's requests admitted to an origin its package declares or one a value supplies entirely; every other request is refused before it is sent (the element raises error.execution).
